name: Giant Fly
appearance: A rideable giant horsefly brought to life from the Ebony Fly figurine.

Figurine.name: Activation
Figurine.effectNote: Use an action to speak the command word and throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 ft. The fly appears if the space is free and large enough.

Figurine.name: Mount and commands
Figurine.effectNote: The fly is friendly, understands the activator’s languages through the item, and follows spoken commands. Without orders it limits itself to self-defense. It can carry a rider for up to 12 hours.

Figurine.name: Reversion and reuse
Figurine.effectNote: The fly becomes a figurine again at the end of 12 hours, at 0 HP, or if the activator uses an action to repeat the command word while touching it. Wait two days before using it again.

notes: Unaligned. The stat block lists no languages. The figurine rules give the fly its understanding of spoken commands.
The 5.1 block supplies no actions, challenge rating, XP, proficiency bonus, or initiative value. The 5.2.1 version supplies CR 0 and is a separate printing.
Source: Wizards of the Coast, System Reference Document 5.1, pp. 221–222.
